title: 2023年英语二真题翻译:诗歌与华兹华斯
intro: Translate the following text from English into Chinese. Write your translation on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)

segments.en: In the late 18th century, William Wordsworth became famous for his poems about nature. And he was one of the founders of a movement called Romanticism, which celebrated the wonders of the natural world.
segments.refZh: 18世纪末期,威廉·华兹华斯因其描写自然的诗歌而闻名。他是浪漫主义运动的奠基人之一,该运动颂扬自然世界的奇迹。
points: in the late 18th century:时间状语前置,译为"18世纪末期"。
became famous for:词组译为"因……而闻名",避免直译"变得出名"。
which celebrated...:非限制性定语从句,顺译或拆译为独立分句,which 指代 Romanticism。
pitfalls: celebrated 此处是动词"颂扬/赞美",勿误译为"庆祝"。
Romanticism 专有名词,译"浪漫主义"。

segments.en: Poetry is powerful. Its energy and rhythm can capture a reader, transport them to another world and make them see things differently.
segments.refZh: 诗歌充满力量。它的能量与节奏能够吸引读者,将他们带入另一个世界,并让他们以不同的方式看待事物。
points: capture a reader:capture 此处意译"吸引/抓住",勿译"捕获"。
transport them...:them 指代 a reader(读者),中文可明化为"他们"。
三个并列动词 capture / transport / make 顺译即可。
pitfalls: transport 勿直译"运输",此处为"带入/引向"。
see things differently:"以不同的方式看待事物",勿译"不同地看东西"。

segments.en: Through carefully selected words and phrases, poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.
segments.refZh: 经过精心挑选的词句,诗歌可以是戏剧性的、有趣的、优美的、动人的和鼓舞人心的。
points: Through...:方式状语前置,译"通过/经过……"。
五个并列形容词转名词性短语排比,保持中文节奏。
moving:此处为"动人的",勿译"移动的"。
pitfalls: selected 译"挑选"而非"选择"更贴文学语境。

segments.en: No one knows for sure when poetry began but it has been around for thousands of years, even before people could write.
segments.refZh: 没有人确切知道诗歌始于何时,但它已存在数千年,甚至在人类会书写之前就已出现。
points: has been around:口语化表达,译"存在/流传"。
even before people could write:让步时间状语,前置或后置皆可。
pitfalls: has been around 勿直译"一直在附近"。
could write 译"会书写/有文字"。

segments.en: It was a way to tell stories and pass down history. It is closely related to song and even when written it is usually created to be performed out loud.
segments.refZh: 它是一种讲述故事、传承历史的方式。它与歌曲密切相关,即使被书写下来,通常也是为了大声朗诵而创作。
points: even when written:省略结构 even when (it is) written,译"即使被书写下来"。
created to be performed out loud:目的状语,译"为大声朗诵而创作"。
pitfalls: performed out loud 勿译"表演出声",此处为"大声朗诵"。
related to song 译"与歌曲密切相关"。

segments.en: Poems really come to life when they are recited. This can also help with understanding them too because the rhythm and sounds of the words become clearer.
segments.refZh: 诗歌在被朗诵时才真正鲜活起来。这也有助于理解诗歌,因为词语的节奏与声响会变得更加清晰。
points: come to life:"鲜活起来/生动起来"。
This 指代"朗诵"这一行为,中文可明化。
because 原因状语从句顺译。
pitfalls: come to life 勿译"来到生命"。
sounds of the words 译"词语的声响"。
